aboutPrivacyStatement.message: Bastion Shield sends no data. No tracking, no telemetry.

aboutPrivacyText.message: Filter lists ship with the extension and are never fetched at runtime. Statistics and history stay in your browser. Broken-site reports are created by you, and you see every detail first.

actClearHistoryText.message: All saved entries and daily statistics are deleted from this device. This can’t be undone.

actEmptyLiveText.message: Open a website in another tab. Blocked requests appear here instantly.

actLead.message: What Bastion Shield blocked, live across all tabs and in the saved history. The data never leaves this device.

actLogOffText.message: Bastion Shield still blocks but records nothing. Turn it on in Settings.

blockedConfirmText.message: Only open this page if you trust the address. The exception applies to this tab only and ends when you close it.

blockedConfirmTextSecurity.message: This page may put your data and device at risk. Only continue if you are sure the warning is wrong. The exception applies to this tab only.

blockedFoot.message: Bastion Shield checks addresses locally against public filter lists. No data is sent anywhere.

blockedProceedFailed.message: The exception could not be set up. Reload the page and try again.

blockedReasonGeneric.message: Bastion Shield stopped this address from loading because it is on a filter list.

blockedReasonSecurity.message: This address is known to spread malware or scams. Pages like this try to steal credentials or install malicious software.

blockedReasonTracking.message: This address belongs to an advertising or tracking service. It was opened directly, so Bastion Shield shows this notice instead of the page.

bounceInvalidText.message: The destination of this redirect is invalid or not a regular web address, so Bastion Shield won’t open it.

bounceSameSiteText.message: The destination belongs to the same website as the redirect. That is not bounce tracking, so Bastion Shield does not open it automatically.

cfAdminText.message: $P1$ rules, managed by your IT team. They apply in addition and can’t be changed here.

cfAdminTextOne.message: $P1$ rule, managed by your IT team. It applies in addition and can’t be changed here.

cfEditorLabel.message: My filters, one rule per line

cfExAllow.message: Turns filtering off for one site

cfExBlockDomain.message: Blocks a domain and all its subdomains

cfExHide.message: Hides an element on one site

cfLead.message: Your own rules in uBlock Origin and Adblock Plus syntax. They apply on top of the filter lists and stay on this device.

cfLeaveText.message: Your filters haven’t been applied yet.

cfLockedText.message: Your organisation doesn’t allow custom filters. The organisation’s filters still apply.

cfScriptletNote.message: Scriptlet filters (##+js) are ignored here. Manifest V3 doesn’t allow code loaded at runtime, so they need a new release of the extension.

cfTooLarge.message: Too many filters for the editor (2 MB at most).

dashErrorText.message: The protection service didn’t respond. Reload the page.

errorSaveFailed.message: Change not saved. Please try again.

extDescription.message: Fast, transparent ad and tracker blocker by Bastion. Open source.

fpStandardHint.message: Adds noise to canvas, WebGL, audio

listsBudgetNote.message: Chrome guarantees every extension $P1$ rules. Beyond that, the browser draws from a pool shared by all extensions.

listsBudgetOverNote.message: Some rules come from the pool shared by all extensions. If it runs out, the browser skips lists at the end of the order.

listsBudgetRegexNote.message: At most $P1$ across all lists. Above that, the browser skips a list’s regex rules; its other rules stay active.

listsFootnote.message: Each list is translated into browser rules when the extension is built. Filters that Manifest V3 cannot express are skipped and counted in the details.

listsLead.message: Bastion Shield combines well-known filter lists such as EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock filters with its own. They are updated with every release of the extension. You can turn lists off, but rarely need to.

listsLockedAllText.message: Changes are disabled. Contact your IT team with questions.

listsLockedAllTitle.message: Filter lists are managed by your organisation

navStatusOffByOrg.message: Temporarily turned off by your organisation

noticeClipTitle.message: Bastion Shield blocked a possible ClickFix attack

noticeClipBody.message: This page tried to put a command on your clipboard. Never paste commands from websites into Run, Terminal or PowerShell.

noticeClipManual.message: If you really need this command, select and copy it yourself – after checking what it does.

noticeLookalikeBody.message: This address looks like $P1$, but it is not: $P2$

noticeLookalikeReasonTypo.message: The address differs by a typing error (typosquatting).

noticeLookalikeReasonCombo.message: The address combines the brand name with other words (combosquatting).

noticeLookalikeHint.message: Check the address before you sign in or pay.

ovChartAria.message: Blocked requests per day over the last 30 days, $P1$ in total

ovHistoryOffText.message: Without history, Bastion Shield shows totals only. History never leaves this device.

ovLocalNote.message: All figures are computed locally on this device and never sent anywhere.

ovNoDataText.message: Browse as usual. What Bastion Shield blocks each day will appear here.

ovTopEmpty.message: No entries in the last 30 days.

popupErrorText.message: Close this window and open it again. If the problem persists, restart the browser.

popupFeedEmpty.message: Nothing blocked yet. New entries appear here instantly.

popupFeedLogOff.message: The activity log is off. Individual requests are not shown.

popupGlobalOffText.message: Bastion Shield is not filtering any website right now. If you have questions, contact your IT department.

popupGlobalOffTitle.message: Protection has been temporarily turned off by your organisation

popupModeAggressiveHint.message: Also blocks the site’s own trackers

popupRulesEmpty.message: No filter rule has matched on this page yet.

popupRulesErrorText.message: The browser declined the request. Try again later.

popupRulesIntro.message: These filters matched on this page. Open a list to see the exact filter text.

popupRulesQuotaText.message: The browser allows only a few automatic queries. Click “Refresh”.

popupRulesSystemHint.message: Bastion Shield’s own rules. They block nothing and don’t count as filter matches.

popupUnfilterableText.message: Browser pages and extension stores are off-limits to extensions. Bastion Shield is active on every other website.

privAmpDesc.message: Opens the publisher’s original page instead of Google’s AMP version.

privCookiesDesc.message: Cookies from other companies’ embedded services. Blocking can interfere with sign-in on some services.

privDebounceDesc.message: Skips intermediate pages that only log your click and opens the destination directly.

privFingerprintDesc.message: Makes it harder to recognise your browser from technical traits. Applies to every site without its own setting.

privFingerprintNote.message: Standard adds imperceptible noise to canvas, WebGL and audio data. Strict also hides the graphics card, languages, speech voices and devices, and may affect some sites.

privFootnote.message: Browser settings apply to the whole profile. If your organisation or another extension controls the same setting, it takes precedence.

privGpcDesc.message: Tells websites not to sell or share your data.

privLead.message: Protection beyond blocking. The defaults match Brave Shields.

privLockedText.message: Locked options are marked with a padlock.

privLockedTitle.message: Settings are managed by your organisation

privParamsDesc.message: Strips identifiers such as fbclid or gclid from links to other sites.

privPingDesc.message: Stops links from silently notifying third parties when clicked (<a ping>).

privSandbox.message: Turn off Privacy Sandbox ad APIs

privSandboxDesc.message: Turns off Topics, Protected Audience and Attribution Reporting in the browser.

privWebrtcDesc.message: Controls which IP addresses video calls and similar services can see.

reportEmailText.message: Your mail app opens a draft to $P1$. Nothing is sent until you send it.

reportGithubText.message: A prefilled, public GitHub issue opens. You can add details before submitting it.

reportMailDescribe.message: What isn’t working? Please describe briefly:

reportNotShared.message: Not shared: page path, query parameters, history and personal data.

setActivityLogDesc.message: Records blocked requests for the popup and dashboard. Without it, Bastion Shield uses even fewer resources.

setBackupDesc.message: Exports settings, site exceptions and custom filters as a JSON file. History is not included.

setBackupImportedPartly.message: Backup restored. Settings set by your organisation stay unchanged.

setBackupImportText.message: Settings, site exceptions and custom filters will be replaced by the backup.

setBackupImportTextDated.message: Settings, site exceptions and custom filters will be replaced by the backup from $P1$.

setBackupInvalid.message: Not a valid Bastion Shield backup.

setBadgeDesc.message: Shows on the extension icon how many requests were blocked on the current page.

setClearHistoryDesc.message: Removes all saved entries and daily statistics.

setHistoryDesc.message: Stores daily statistics and entries locally, without query strings. Nothing is sent anywhere.

setLead.message: How Bastion Shield works and what it keeps on this device.

setModeDesc.message: Standard allows the site’s own content, like Brave Shields. Aggressive blocks it too and may affect more sites.

setResetDesc.message: Restores all settings to their defaults and removes site exceptions and custom filters. History is kept.

setResetDonePartly.message: Reset to defaults. Settings set by your organisation stay unchanged.

setResetText.message: Settings, site exceptions and custom filters will be lost. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.

setRetentionDesc.message: Older entries are deleted automatically every day.

sitesAddHint.message: A new exception turns protection off for the site. You can then adjust each setting individually.

sitesEmptyText.message: Every site is protected with the defaults. You can also set exceptions straight from the popup.

sitesFootnote.message: The export is a JSON file you can import on another device. Import also accepts a text file with one site per line.

sitesImportInvalid.message: The file contains no valid sites.

sitesImportText.message: $P1$ sites will be imported. Existing entries for the same sites are overwritten.

sitesImportTextOne.message: $P1$ site will be imported. An existing entry for the same site is overwritten.

sitesInvalid.message: Please enter a valid website address, e.g. example.com.

sitesLead.message: Settings that apply to individual sites only. Every other site follows the defaults. An exception also covers all subdomains.

welcomeLead.message: Your browser is now protected from ads, trackers and known malicious sites. There is nothing to set up.

welcomeLocalText.message: No telemetry, no account, no cloud. Statistics stay in your browser.

welcomeOnText.message: Blocks ads and trackers with every list under «Filter lists», plus protection against fingerprinting and tracking redirects.

welcomePin.message: Tip: pin Bastion Shield via the puzzle icon in the toolbar to keep the counter in view.

welcomeSeeText.message: The popup shows, for every page, what was blocked and which filter rule matched.

savingsEstimateNote.message: Estimate: blocked requests times the typical size and load time per type (script, image, frame …).

setIncidentCtaDesc.message: Link to Bastion's emergency contact. When off, only «Bastion Shield» is shown there.

nerdBisectNeedsProtection.message: bisect: turn protection on for this site first

nerdBisectFoundMany.message: Found: these hosts break the page only together

nerdBisectPartial.message: not clearly separable – the page works with all of them together

nerdBisectLocked.message: your filters are locked by your organisation

nerdBisectError.message: bisect step failed, please try again

nerdSlAllowed.message: exception for $P1$ added – reload the page

nerdSlPolicy.message: nerd mode is set by your organisation

nerdCmdPlaceholder.message: type a command — bisect, why, blame, allow …

nerdCmdBadHost.message: not a valid host or URL

nerdCmdBisectCancel.message: stop the bisect, block as before

nerdCmdWhy.message: check a URL against the installed rules

nerdCmdAllow.message: exception for a host on this site

nerdCmdCopyReport.message: page report as JSON to the clipboard

nerdBisectAsk.message: $P1$ hosts let through – does the page work now?

nerdBisectAskOne.message: $P1$ host let through – does the page work now?

nerdBisectClean.message: not a network block — more likely a cosmetic filter, a scriptlet or the site itself

cmdNerdBisect.message: Nerd mode: start or stop the bisect (find the breaking filter) on this tab

nerdSettingsEnabledDesc.message: Developer tools, command line (Ctrl+K), context menu and bisect. Nothing leaves this device.

nerdSettingsContextMenuDesc.message: Adds «Bastion Shield» to the right-click menu: check why a link or image is blocked, test or look up selected filter text, find the breaking filter, open the developer tools.

nerdSettingsFilterHistoryDesc.message: Shows «GitHub ↗» next to matched filters in the popup and in Activity, linking to the filter's upstream history.

nerdSettingsFpMeterDesc.message: Counts per page how often canvas, WebGL, audio and other fingerprinting APIs are read.

nerdSettingsLookalikeDesc.message: Warns when an address looks confusingly similar to a protected domain (typos, look-alike characters, brand name with extra words).

nerdSettingsDomainsHint.message: One domain per line, e.g. your bank’s. Lookalikes of these domains trigger the warning.

nerdSettingsDomainsInvalid.message: Saved. Not valid domain names, left out: $P1$

nerdLabLead.message: Test filters, check URLs against the installed rules, verify checksums and open a filter’s history on GitHub.

nerdLabOffText.message: Turn it on in Settings to open the developer tools.

nerdLabPlayLead.message: Test filters against real requests. Dry run: nothing is blocked or saved.

nerdLabFiltersHint.message: One filter per line. Network filters are tested; cosmetic filters are only listed.

nerdLabHistoryHint.message: History only holds requests Bastion already blocked or redirected. Paste URLs to test anything else.

nerdLabHistoryCountNone.message: No recorded requests yet. They are added while you browse, whenever Bastion blocks or redirects something.

nerdLabHistoryCountNoneSite.message: No recorded requests for this site.

nerdLabHistoryOffText.message: Without history there are no recorded requests. Paste URLs, or turn history on in Settings.

nerdLabUrlsHint.message: One request per line: URL [type] [page], e.g. https://ads.example/a.js script news.ch. Without a type it is guessed from the file extension (you can change it in the result); without a page the request counts as third-party.

nerdLabNoRequests.message: No requests to test against. Choose history or paste URLs.

nerdLabTruncated.message: Only the first 1’000 filters were compiled.

nerdLabCosmeticNote.message: Cosmetic filter: acts on the page, not on the network, so it is not dry-run here.

nerdLabScriptletNote.message: Scriptlet: needs an extension release (MV3 forbids runtime code), so it is not dry-run here.

nerdLabInertNote.message: Produces no rule, e.g. a $$badfilter or a filter cancelled by one.

nerdLabDecided.message: decides $P1$ of $P2$ (another filter wins the rest)

nerdLabAlready.message: $P1$ of them already handled by your lists

nerdLabAlreadyOne.message: $P1$ of them already handled by your lists

nerdLabUncertain.message: Cannot be checked without a server response, so ignored: $P1$.

nerdLabUrlsCapped.message: Truncated: only the first matches are listed.

nerdLabIntegrityLead.message: Computes the SHA-256 checksum of every installed rule file here in the browser and compares it with the value recorded at build time.

nerdLabIntegrityBad.message: $P1$ of $P2$ files differ or are missing.

nerdLabIntegrityOtherBuild.message: Note: integrity.json comes from a different build than meta.json.

nerdLabIntegrityMissingText.message: This version has no rulesets/integrity.json; newer builds write it.

nerdLabIntegrityCaption.message: Self-check: compares the installed files with the checksums from the build. This is not a signature: anyone who can change the files can change the checksums too. The store signature vouches for the package as a whole.

nerdLabProvLead.message: What the build of $P1$ (version $P2$) downloaded: source, SHA-256, size and version of every list.

nerdLabBlameLead.message: Shows when and why a filter line was added to its list (GitHub).

nerdLabBlameNoneText.message: The selected lists do not come from a GitHub repository whose files we know.

nerdLabBlameNoText.message: No filter text is recorded for this rule.

nerdLabBlameCaption.message: Opens github.com in a new tab. Only the filter text is sent, never an address you visited.

nerdLabHistoryTitle.message: Shows when and why a filter line was added to its list (GitHub)

nerdMenuTestFilter.message: Test selection in the filter tester

nerdLabExplainNone.message: Result: would load normally – no installed rule matches.

nerdLabExplainCapped.message: Only the first $P1$ matching rules are listed.

nerdLabExplainMax.message: Only the first $P1$ URLs are checked against the installed rules.

nerdLabExplainFailed.message: The installed rules could not be read.

nerdLabReasonSiteOff.message: – protection is off for this website

nerdLabReasonProceed.message: – you chose “Continue anyway” on the block page

nerdLabReasonBisect.message: – let through by the running bisect test

nerdLabReasonStandard1p.message: – Standard mode allows the website’s own content

nerdLabCounterfactualNone.message: Without this exception: would load normally (no blocking rule)

nerdLabExplainDerived.message: This rule merges $P1$ filters; the text for this domain is derived from the rule’s domain list.

privClipboardDesc.message: Stops websites from secretly putting commands on your clipboard that try to trick you into running them (ClickFix: PowerShell, mshta, curl | sh). What you copy yourself is left alone.
